uslaw-usc-t2-s143b:
Section 143b of Title 2 of the United States Code allows the Library of Congress to pay in advance for subscriptions and other charges. It sits in Chapter 5 of Title 2, on the Library, current through Public Law 119-134. The provision is a single sentence with a start date.

From and after October 1, 1980, payments in advance may be made by the Librarian of Congress for a stated list of things. The list covers charges for bibliographic data, publications, materials in any other form, and services. The Librarian may pay in advance whenever doing so is judged more prompt, efficient, or cheap, in the interest of carrying out required Library programs.
